title: Top horizontal menu and user menu
summary: On a wide screen the main menu now runs across the top with clear groups, an account menu next to your avatar, and a notification bell that opens fully. On a phone, the hamburger menu, bell and account controls stay easy to reach with a keyboard.

added: A top menu with grouped dropdowns for Home, Communications, People, Operations, Support, Apps and More (and the matching Admin groups on admin pages).
An account menu on your avatar for My profile, Notification settings, Security and Sign out.
Staff and Admin switch beside the logo on desktop, and inside the phone menu for admins.
changed: The notification bell sits only in the top bar and opens a full panel that is no longer cut off by the side menu.
Account links live in the account menu only; People keeps directory, organisation chart and students.
fixed: The phone notification bell opens its panel, and the drawer no longer copies an unwired bell.
accessibility: Shell controls are at least 44 by 44 pixels, work with keyboard and Escape, and keep a usable layout down to about 320px wide.

internal_notes: Epic #319. Leaves #320–#324. Navigation uses disclosures, not an ARIA menubar. Bell panel uses the HTML popover top layer. Tag v0.5.8 after merge is a Bambie override (latest tag is already v0.6.10).
